}}'''Edarna Noregovna''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Blue Ajah]] who was raised to the [[Amyrlin Seat]] in the year {{Ne|64}}.

== History ==
Her name could indicate a [[Kandori]] origin, given the ending of her surname being prominent in Kandori names.

Edarna held the position for fifty-one years until her death in {{Ne|115}}, the longest Amyrlin's reign during this era. She was [[Dalaine Ndaye]]'s successor and [[Balladare Arandaille]]'s predecessor.{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

She was a strong Amyrlin. It is thought she was one of the most politically skilled women to ever hold the staff and stole.{{Ref/book|10|30}}
